Frequently Asked Questions

Do safety films meet school security code requirements?

Our safety and security films are tested to ANSI Z97.1 and CPSC 16 CFR 1201 standards. Many Arizona school districts require these certifications for glazing upgrades. We provide full compliance documentation with every installation.

Can films reduce glare on smartboards and screens?

Yes. Anti-glare window films significantly reduce indirect glare that causes washout on smartboards, projector screens, and computer monitors. Teachers consistently report improved classroom engagement and reduced eye strain after installation.

Is summer break the best time for installation?

Summer is ideal for school installations — empty classrooms allow our crews to work efficiently without disrupting the academic schedule. We partner with facilities departments to complete projects before fall semester.
